Ilya Novak: quick poll 1 Our bulk-create/edit modal has ~8 fields across 3 collapsible groups. On submit failures, do we rely on inline-only errors or show an error summary that lets people jump to fields? Also want to settle required-markers on collapsed headers. Caroline Wu: summary + inline. Inline is great for context, but when sections collapse users won't see the errors. Summary should be compact and optionally dismissible. Rafael Ortiz: agree. make summary items keyboard buttons that expand group + focus field. Also include a short sr-only heading like "Form errors" so screen readers get context. Noah Khan: small perf/UX note: don't render full list of 100s of errors for huge bulk ops. cap to first 10 and show "X more". But for our use case 8 fields, show all. Zoe Park: required-marker nit: asterisk alone is ambiguous. Use visible "*" and add sr-only text "required" for assistive tech. For collapsed groups show a badge "1 required" or "2 errors" depending on state. Ilya Novak: aria/live semantics question: should the summary use role="alert" or aria-live="polite"? We want to announce after submit but avoid spam if inline messages also appear. Caroline Wu: use assertive for the summary on submit, but debounce announcements so if multiple updates happen quickly we only announce once. For inline messages keep aria-hidden for the visual-only error text and rely on aria-describedby on the input to be read when focused. Rafael Ortiz: example markup idea: ```html

Form errors

3 problems found. Use the list to jump to each error.

Please enter a valid email
``` Noah Khan: on button click handler: expand parent group if collapsed, then set focus to the input and call input.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}) to avoid it being hidden under sticky headers. Also set focus after expansion animation completes. Zoe Park: mobile screen readers can be noisy. For small screens consider disabling assertive announcements and instead focus the summary container so VO/TalkBack reads it naturally. We'll need to test on device. Ilya Novak: typed-confirmation policy for destructive bulk ops? Options: typed token (e.g., DELETE), typed resource name, or checkbox + confirm. What's our recommendation? Caroline Wu: rule proposal: irreversible delete = typed confirmation (explicit token). reversible actions (archive, move) = checkbox + confirm. For very large sets (>200 items) consider forcing typed confirmation regardless. Rafael Ortiz: copy suggestion: "This will permanently delete 14 models. This action cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm." show the exact token in monospace next to the input. Noah Khan: accessibility for typed input: label should read out the exact token, input should have aria-required and an error state if mismatched. Don't auto-focus the input for screen reader sessions; instead focus the dialog and let users navigate to the input. Zoe Park: test cases to add to a11y QA: - keyboard only: jump to error summary, expand groups, navigate to input, restore focus after dismiss - VoiceOver: ensure summary announcement and that pressing list item moves to field - TalkBack: verify scrollIntoView behavior on Android a11y-bot: scan report: 3 warnings on feature/bulk-ux (missing aria-describedby on 2 fields; modal lacks accessible name). See CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/8901 Ilya Novak: decisions: inline + dismissible summary banner with clickable items. Required markers: visible asterisk + sr-only "required". Typed confirmations for permanent deletes; threshold=200. Caroline Wu: I'll add a Figma frame + interaction notes for expand+focus behavior. Rafael Ortiz: I'll add JS helpers for jump-to-error with animation callback. Small code sketch in the PR. Noah Khan: I'll own QA tests for keyboard and mobile screen readers. Zoe Park: I'll draft copy variants for typed vs checkbox confirm and share in #copy-review. Ilya Novak: action items + deadlines: - Caroline: prototype with summary banner and jump-to-field interactions (Figma + link) 1 Apr EOD - Rafael: implement helper + unit tests in branch feature/bulk-jump 6 Apr - Noah: a11y test matrix and run on devices 7 Apr - Zoe: copy drafts for confirmation modals 4 Apr a11y-bot: reminder: attach accessibility checklist to PRs for bulk forms. Ilya Novak: thanks everyone. tagging @product to review the typed-confirm threshold later. closing thread for now.
